ranked.headline: LLM and ML models decode tissue, cell, and drug-response biology from omics data
ranked.summary: Foundation models, LLM agents, and interpretable ensembles are now applied across spatial proteomics, histology, and single-cell datasets.

ranked.headline: Latent and fusion models integrate heterogeneous biological data across modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published study pair multimodal encoders with task-specific priors, fusion, or distributional objectives.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test whether reported performance holds under realistic data perturbations
ranked.summary: An audit found only 9 of 50 protein-ligand affinity models statistically reproducible, while linear baselines match most single-cell foundation models.

ranked.headline: External evidence layers are being used to prioritize and diagnose causal variants
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs variant prioritization with external evidence, from agentic workflows to automated rare disease reanalysis and regulatory deep learning.

ranked.headline: Inferring functional consequences of variants from screens, models, and benchmarks
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs NMD prediction, tiling CRISPR screens, and donor-resolved benchmarks to resolve variant effects.

ranked.headline: Constrained models align, trace and order spatial transcriptomic tissue structure
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics analyses increasingly require alignment, trajectory and gradient inference that respects tissue architecture.

ranked.headline: Statistical corrections for bias and spatial dependence in single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications address calibration of differential, spatial, and imputed single-cell and spatial omics inference.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map transient pockets and persistent binding contacts
ranked.summary: Simulation-based binding analyses now separate transient binding pockets, persistent residue contacts and redundant energy terms in protein complexes.

ranked.headline: Moving genomic filtering and graph analysis into SSD storage to cut data movement
ranked.summary: Sequence and imaging workloads are being restructured around storage and input data to cut index and data-movement costs.

ranked.headline: Structure predictors are being placed inside protein and ligand design loops
ranked.summary: Structure prediction is moving from final readout into iterative design loops for binders and drug-binding proteins.

ranked.headline: Biological sequence models are being conditioned on auxiliary context across modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair protein and DNA language-model embeddings with added context for enzyme, localization, and interaction tasks.

ranked.headline: Validating microbiome and bacterial genomics pipelines for reliable inference
ranked.summary: Pipelines and differential abundance tools for microbiome and bacterial genomics are being benchmarked for reproducibility and reliable taxa inference.

ranked.headline: Aging clocks from methylation and transcriptomes test artifacts in molecular aging
ranked.summary: Aging clocks are now applied to tumours and transcriptomes while smoothing methods are shown to generate artifactual aging waves.

ranked.headline: ML models and library design sharpen antigen-specificity prediction for T and B cells
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair protein language models and Bayesian mixtures with pMHC, TCR, and B-cell epitope data to model antigen recognition.

ranked.headline: Locus-resolved mapping of regulatory and chromatin features in human genomes
ranked.summary: Standardized resources and haplotype-resolved long-read methods now resolve regulatory and chromatin features at individual loci across populations.

ranked.headline: Sequence and structure-conditioned models predict and design biomolecule function
ranked.summary: Protein language models and generative frameworks now predict and design expression, binding, and activity directly from sequence.

ranked.headline: Reducing stochastic and heterogeneous biological systems to tractable effective models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published cancer model address how large stochastic and heterogeneous biological systems can be reduced to tractable descriptions.

ranked.headline: Exploring the Effects of Entanglement on Quantum Machine Learning of Pathogen Epitope-Receptor Binding
ranked.summary: Hybrid quantum neural network study varying entanglement topology in feature maps to classify strong vs weak 9-mer epitope-receptor binding for PRRS vaccine…

ranked.headline: Reduced-resolution and atomistic simulation of DNA and RNA ensembles at scale
ranked.summary: Large-scale atomistic DNA hexamer data and a fast coarse-grained RNA model are extending nucleic acid simulation coverage.

ranked.headline: Evaluating vectors for the design of a spillover-disrupting Lassa virus transmissible vaccine.
ranked.summary: Lassa fever is a viral zoonotic disease that sickens tens of thousands of people each year when it spills over from its rodent reservoir throughout West Africa.

ranked.headline: Causal mediation and measurement error models for high-dimensional biomedical data
ranked.summary: High-dimensional biomedical datasets demand mediation and error-aware models that handle covariate dependence and noisy measurements jointly.

ranked.headline: Deep learning de novo peptide sequencing faces prior bias and FDR calibration needs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address sequence-prior bias and false discovery rate calibration in deep-learning de novo peptide sequencing models.

ranked.headline: Single-cell data quantify fate predictability and lineage-aware expression dynamics
ranked.summary: Information-theoretic and lineage-aware stochastic models quantify when single-cell data make future fate predictable.

ranked.headline: Learned biomedical representations evaluated across RNA-seq, ctDNA and histopathology
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and atlas-scale models test what biomedical embeddings and ctDNA detectors preserve under explicit, reference-based evaluation.

ranked.headline: Automated reconstruction and sampling of genome-scale metabolic models across organisms
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend constraint-based models to gut microbes, human mitochondria, GPR rules, and minimal pathway enumeration.

ranked.headline: Simulation and experiment-guided modeling capture dynamic protein ensembles and allostery
ranked.summary: New tools target dynamic ensembles and directional allosteric networks, moving beyond single static structures toward measurement-consistent models.

ranked.headline: Open computational tools model protein flexibility and protein-peptide interfaces
ranked.summary: Open tools now span coarse-grained flexibility simulation, MD-derived peptide interface signatures, and multi-model structure prediction.

ranked.headline: Network topology and synaptic motifs shape emergent neural dynamics in models
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now link measured or specified connectivity, motifs and neuromodulator innervation to population dynamics and spiking group formation.

ranked.headline: Multiresolution graph methods make high-dimensional omics data more interpretable
ranked.summary: Recent items introduce graph-based and multi-resolution summaries for interpreting cytometry, spatial transcriptomic, and gene set enrichment data.

ranked.headline: Curated computational resources and classifiers for protein sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Curated, atomically verified sequence resources and interpretable classifiers are now applied to variant, repeat, and Fe-S protein analyses.

ranked.headline: Function and mechanism rules guide enzyme design and substrate channeling
ranked.summary: Recent work encodes enzyme function, reaction mechanism and metabolon assembly as explicit constraints on molecular design and prediction.

ranked.headline: Reference genome assemblies for non-model parasites, crustaceans and vertebrates
ranked.summary: Long-read assemblies now span a parasitic flatworm, a sex-chromosome-bearing lobster and 816 vertebrate reference genomes.

ranked.headline: Recurrent E/I and attractor network models link stress, memory, and hippocampal gating
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model connect chronic stress, attractor dynamics, and hippocampal gating to working-memory flexibility and relearning.

ranked.headline: Noise-aware quantification of gene expression, fitness, and cell-free transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Single-cell noise modeling, clone-resolved RNAi fitness profiling, and Bayesian buffer tuning for direct RNA-seq appeared together in late June 2026.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of regulatory networks from multi-omics and prior knowledge
ranked.summary: Recent frameworks couple sequence, epigenomic, dynamic and ontology-derived information to infer regulatory networks from heterogeneous data.

ranked.headline: Simulated evolution benchmarks whether ancestors and intermediates are recoverable
ranked.summary: Simulated ground-truth evolution now lets reconstruction methods for ancestors and intermediates be scored directly against known trajectories.

ranked.headline: Effect-size ranking and k-mer methods for reliable regulatory inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address how effect magnitude, repeat-aware k-mer counts and nucleosome-structure benchmarks govern reliability of regulatory inference.

ranked.headline: Alignment-free, consensus and multi-method tools reshape microbial sequence analysis
ranked.summary: New bacterial genomics tools replace alignment or single-method units with alignment-free, consensus and assembly-integration frameworks.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained models link chromatin and RNP condensate conformation to phase behavior
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained models now connect nucleosome spacing, remodeling and protein-RNA binding to condensate organization and phase behavior.

ranked.headline: Exact and approximate parsimony methods extend to phylogenetic networks and genomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints give polynomial-time, approximation, and exact solvers for parsimony problems on phylogenetic networks and ancestral genomes.
